methodologyNotes: This dataset covers 13 burr coffee grinders spanning electric espresso, electric filter, and manual categories, selected for high search volume and current availability in 2026. Specs were sourced from manufacturer product pages (Baratza, Fellow, Breville, Eureka, DF64 Coffee, Niche Coffee, 1Zpresso, Comandante, Timemore, OXO) and corroborated via specialty retailers (Clive Coffee, Seattle Coffee Gear, Whole Latte Love, Prima Coffee) and review outlets (The Coffee Folk, Complete Home Barista, Coffeeness). Weights are in pounds (lbs), burr sizes in millimeters, hopper capacity in grams, priceUsd reflects published US MSRP or standard US retail price as verified on live pages 2026-06-19. Adversarial re-verification corrected the Breville Smart Grinder Pro weight (shipping weight had been mislabeled as unit weight), filled the Fellow Opus weight, fixed the Fellow Opus source URL (pointed to the wrong Opus 2 page), and adjusted the 1Zpresso J-Max price to the published Amazon figure. All 13 products are real and verifiable; none were removed.

products.name: 1Zpresso ZP6 Special
products.priceNote: Official 1Zpresso store lists US$209.00 ("$ 209.00", "Tax excl.", "The price above is in USD"). The retailer corroboration (Rogue Wave Coffee) is priced in EUR (€182,95), so the USD figure is sourced from the manufacturer store.
products.provenance: Both pages re-fetched verbatim with fetch-clean.mjs and each retained spec was confirmed against the fetched text. Source (1zpresso.coffee/product/zp6-special/): title "ZP6 Special Manual Coffee Grinder" (type=manual); price "$ 209.00" with "Tax excl." and "The price above is in USD" (priceUsd=209); "48mm Hexagonal Burrs" / "special hexagonal stainless steel burr crafted for pour-over coffee" (burr_size_mm=48, burr_type=hexagonal); "external adjustment ring with 90 clicks and 22-micron precision" (grind_settings); "Grounds Capacity: 30~35g" (hopper_capacity_g=35, verbatim upper bound); listed under the "Pour Over" category (best_for=pourover). Corroboration (roguewavecoffee.ca) confirms the same model as a manual pour-over grinder with "48mm Hexagonal Stainless Steel burrs", "9 numbers and 90 clicks" where "Each click shifts the grind size by 22 microns" via a top adjustment dial, and "Ground Capacity: 30-35 g"; it is priced in EUR (€182,95). burr_type recorded as "hexagonal" because that is the exact term both pages use — neither page ever says "conical", so "conical" would be an unsourced inference. CORRECTION: weight_lb was previously 1.54 and is now nulled. Neither fetched page states the weight as 1.54 lb: the manufacturer states only "Weight: 700g" (grams), while the retailer states "~750g (1.65lb)" — the only verbatim pound figure, which contradicts 1.54. 1.54 lb is a gram→pound conversion of the manufacturer's 700g, not a verbatim value, and the two sources disagree on the underlying weight, so it fails the verbatim/unambiguous test and is nulled. hopper_capacity_g=35 is kept because "35" appears verbatim in the "30~35g" / "30-35 g" grounds-capacity strings on both pages. No release year is stated on either page (earliest customer reviews are dated Dec 2022/Jan 2023, but that is not an explicit release statement), so releaseDate and specs.release remain null. Exact model confirmed as ZP6 Special on both pages ("1Zpresso ZP6 Special manual coffee grinder", "This ZP6 is the same as ZP6 Special"), distinct from the original ZP6 (Rogue Wave notes the top adjustment dial "is different from the original ZP6"). 6 of 8 specKeys survive (>half); model confirmed, so publish=true.
